verses.text: “What a help you’ve been to someone with no power! What a rescue for an arm with no strength!
What advice you’ve given to someone with no wisdom! You’ve poured out so much sound knowledge!
Who were you speaking to? Whose spirit spoke through you?
“The spirits of the dead tremble beneath the waters, along with all who live there.
Sheol lies bare before God. Nothing covers Abaddon.
He stretches the north over empty space and hangs the earth on nothing.
He wraps water up in thick clouds, and the clouds don’t burst under its weight.
He covers the face of his throne and spreads his cloud over it.
He draws a boundary on the surface of the waters, where light and darkness meet.
The pillars of heaven shake, stunned at his rebuke.
By his power he stirs up the sea. By his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
By his Spirit the heavens are made beautiful. His hand pierced the swift serpent.
Look, we’ve only seen the edges of his ways. We hear barely a whisper of him. Who could understand the thunder of his power?”
